title: Easy and effective
body: This app offers so much to improve your day to day life asking you various questions and creates you a personalized routine so that you can improve on yourself. Give it a try and see for yourself.
author: Shresuttam

title: Doesn’t Open after Update
body:
I was enjoying using this app a lot and it was super helpful keeping my resolutions on track but it won’t open today after the update. 
It says loading but then just stops at the end.
author: Raych in Japan
